description: International club competitions whose cross-league matches teach the football rating book a per-(domestic competition, metric) league-strength correction, and the step per metric (epochs.FOOTBALL_CUP_STRENGTH_FROM_UTC, bet.sofa.cup_strength). Steps chosen on TRAIN (2024-07-01..2025-06-30) per metric; only metrics better out of sample (TEST from 2025-07-01, and from 2026-01-01 as a check) with the match-bootstrap interval below zero carry one - corners_for and shots_on_target_for did not. Evidence: docs/sofa/evidence/cross_league_cups_2026-10-15.md (section 'Wariant E').
